The National Account Manager is responsible for identifying, developing, and growing strategic national account opportunities across the Foodservice trade channel.

This role requires an experienced national accounts hunter with a proven track record of building, expanding, and maintaining customer relationships across a variety of foodservice segments, including QSR, fast casual, casual dining, family dining, hospitality, and emerging growth channels.

The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial discipline, customer insight, and cross-functional leadership to advance branded, custom, and exclusive fully cooked protein solutions from concept through commercialization, while delivering profitable growth, distribution expansion, and long-term customer value.

· Own and grow a portfolio of national foodservice accounts, with emphasis on strategic chains, emerging growth customers, and new business opportunities across the foodservice trade channel.
· Develop and execute customer-specific annual and multi-year business plans that deliver revenue, volume, margin, distribution, innovation, and profitability objectives.
· Identify, qualify, and advance new account opportunities by building a strong sales pipeline, leveraging customer insights, market trends, menu needs, and the company’s fully cooked protein cap

Stellenangebot: Senior Account Executive – Enterprise Industrial Software (m/w/d) Für unser Unternehmen, einen führenden SaaS-Enablement-Dienstleister , suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n engagierte/n und erfahrene/n Senior Account Executive – Enterprise Industrial Software (m/w/d) .

SingularitySales ist bekannt für erstklassige Leistungen im Bereich Go-to-Market und der Skalierung innovativer Softwarelösungen. Wir legen besonderen Wert auf eine moderne Unternehmenskultur, die Offenheit, Innovation und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung fördert.

Als Senior Account Executive (m/w/d) bist du eine zentrale Säule unseres Vertriebsteams im Bereich Enterprise Industrial Software und spielst eine entscheidende Rolle beim Aufbau und Closing strategischer Deals mit Großkunden aus dem Fertigungsumfeld.

Dein Fokus liegt darauf, Kundenbedarfe präzise zu analysieren, maßgeschneiderte Softwarelösungen zu präsentieren und Entscheidungsträger bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss zu begleiten. Dabei baust du langfristige Partnerschaften auf und positionierst das Produkt-Portfolio strategisch in deinem Marktbereich.

Wenn du dich durch exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten, starkes Business-Verständnis im industriellen Umfeld und eine nachweisbare Erfolgsbilanz im Closing komplexer Enterprise-Deals auszeichnest, freuen wir uns auf deine Unterstützung.

Dich erwartet eine anspruchsvolle Rolle mit hoher Verantwortung – und die Möglichkeit, deine Karriere auf das nächste Level zu bringen, eingebettet in ein dynamisches Umfeld, das lebenslanges Lernen, Entwicklung und gemeinsame Erfolge fördert.

Sei Teil eines Teams, das mit Leidenschaft innovative Softwarelösungen vorantreibt, nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut und ambitionierte Wachstumsziele realisiert. Requirements Deine Mission: Als Senior Account Executive (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Outsourcing-Teams für einen führenden Anbieter industrieller Softwarelösungen.

Deine Mission: den kompletten Sales-Cycle eigenverantwortlich zu steuern – von der präzisen Analyse der Kundenbedarfe über die Präsentation maßgeschneiderter Enterprise-Lösungen bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

Dabei agierst du als vertrauensvoller Partner im Namen unseres Kunden, baust langfristige Beziehungen mit Entscheidungsträgern auf und positionierst das Portfolio strategisch im Markt. Mit deinem Beitrag stellst du sicher, dass Wachstum messbar wird und die Sales-Exzellenz unseres Kunden nachhaltig gestärkt wird.

Deine Aufgaben: Closing & Deal Ownership: Verantwortung für den gesamten Abschlussprozess – vom ersten Meeting (ausführliche Discovery und Business Case) bis hin zur erfolgreichen Vertragsunterzeichnung.

Kundenberatung: Analyse komplexer Anforderungen aus dem Manufacturing- und Industrieumfeld, Präsentation maßgeschneiderter Softwarelösungen und Positionierung des Produktportfolios als strategischer Mehrwert.

Beziehungsmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Partnerschaften mit Entscheidern und Key Accounts in Fertigungsunternehmen, um nachhaltiges Wachstum zu sichern. Vertriebsstrategie: Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Go-to-Market-Ansätzen im Namen des Kunden, mit Fokus auf Effizienz und Impact im industriellen Enterprise-Umfeld.

CRM- & Pipeline-Management: Sicherstellen einer präzisen Forecasting- und Opportunity-Steuerung im CRM-System, um volle Transparenz über den Sales-Funnel zu gewährleisten. Markt- & Wettbewerbsanalyse: Beobachtung von Trends im Bereich Industrial Software & Manufacturing, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und Kunden proaktiv zu beraten.

Reporting & KPI-Steuerung: Erstellung von regelmäßigen Berichten zu Sales-Performance, Conversion Rates und Forecasts für Management und Stakeholder. Dein Profil: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Solution-Selling, idealerweise im Bereich Enterprise Software, Industrial Software oder SaaS im Fertigungsumfeld.

Nachweisbare Erfolge im Closing komplexer Deals und in der Erreichung oder Übertreffung ambitionierter Vertriebsziele. Tiefes Verständnis für industrielle Geschäftsmodelle sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Softwarelösungen in klaren Business-Value zu übersetzen.

Starke kommunikative und überzeugende Fähigkeiten auf C-Level – schriftlich, telefonisch und in Präsentationen. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Forecasting und Opportunity-Management. Strategisches Mindset kombiniert mit Hands-on-Mentalität, um Kunden durch den gesamten Sales Cycle zu führen.

Hohe Eigenmotivation, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld erfolgreich zu agieren. Wir bieten: 100% Remote – arbeite von wo du willst, in einem globalen Team mit echtem Impact. Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket inklusive leistungsbezogener Boni.

Direkter Zugang zu Entscheidern – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen. Ein Umfeld, das High Performer fordert und fördert – ohne Corporate-Bremsen. Ein engagiertes und leidenschaftliches Team, das Werte wie Innovation, Integrität und Teamarbeit hochhält.

Highlights Enterprise-Deals im industriellen Softwareumfeld – von der Pipeline bis zum Abschluss, 100% remote, 100% ownership. 🚀 Originally posted on Himalayas

As an Account Executive for Uber Eats, you are on the frontline of our fastest-growing business, introducing restaurant partners to our platform and helping them grow their businesses in an increasingly competitive landscape.

This role isn't about pushing a product-it's about building long-term partnerships in a fast-changing environment where the pace is intense and the stakes are high. You'll need to be resilient, resourceful, and energized by the messy reality of the sales cycle, moving with urgency to turn prospects into successful, high-performing partners.

What you'll do Manage the entire end-to-end sales cycle, from prospecting and cold calling to pitching, contract negotiation, and closing deals that drive significant business growth. Leverage local knowledge to identify and bring on the best restaurants in strategic markets, ensuring our selection meets the diverse needs of our users.

Communicate the value of Uber Eats and our latest product features clearly, removing barriers to entry and helping partners reach their specific business goals. Collaborate across operations and onboarding teams to ensure a seamless transition for new partners, setting them up for measurable success within their first month on the platform.

Own restaurant partner performance during the critical first 28 days, providing consultative support to ensure a strong start and long-term retention. Proactively identify and redesign inefficient internal processes, ensuring the team can move quickly and succeed at a massive scale despite shifting priorities.

Basic Qualifications Minimum 1 year of professional experience in a quota-carrying sales role. Proven experience negotiating contracts and managing a complex sales pipeline. Demonstrated ability to identify customer needs and present tailored solutions. Proficiency in CRM software, such as Salesforce, to manage sales activities.

Degree level education (Bachelor's degree or equivalent). Preferred Qualifications Experience in the food delivery, hospitality, or e-commerce marketplace industries. Extraordinary listening and communication skills, with the ability to adjust your style to a wide variety of audiences.

A resourceful and persistent attitude, with a relentless drive to achieve goals and overcome objections. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Proven track record of meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets. Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

Our client, eBrands, is in search of a seasoned Amazon Sales Manager to form part of our dynamic team and optimize a growing portfolio of our Amazon brands.

As a key figure in one of our brand management teams, you'll be instrumental in scaling our brands on Amazon, encompassing a broad range of tasks from strategic listing management to advanced PPC strategies, inventory forecasting to groundbreaking marketing initiatives.

Your expertise in scaling private label brands on Amazon will be paramount, and your familiarity with other platforms (e.g., Walmart, eBay) and marketing avenues outside Amazon would be a definite plus.

Joining our dynamic start-up means being part of a multifaceted, vibrant team, where you will independently strategize and implement decisions, collaborate with your team & your manager as well as leadership figures, and engage with specialists to drive our brand growth.

With our portfolio of brands growing at an unprecedented pace, your ability to help with steering these brands towards greater heights will be instrumental to our business's onward growth!

Core Responsibilities: Strategic Sales Growth: Elevate the sales and profitability of our brands on Amazon through sophisticated traffic and conversion strategies, market expansion, and orchestrating new product launches.
Traffic Growth: Collaboratively pinpoint opportunities for advanced Amazon PPC campaigns (alongside our growth marketers), ensuring growth and efficient cost structures. Also strategize the influx of external traffic, drawing from avenues like social media and other PPC endeavors.
Analytical Oversight: Harness a plethora of data from Amazon and auxiliary systems for actionable insights, measuring the implications of strategies deployed.
Conversion Excellence: Take charge of listing optimization (e.g., titles, bullet points, imagery, attributes). Keep a vigilant eye on ASIN performance metrics, rankings, customer reviews, and ratings.
New Product Development: Recognize and act upon emerging product opportunities, steering the ideation to launch phase seamlessly on Amazon.
Work Flexibility: This is a fully remote position. We are flexible with where you want to work, as long as you can work +/- 2 hours Eastern European Time.
Required Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Business/Management or an equivalent level of work experience
A minimum of 4+ years of Amazon-centric experience.
Demonstrated success in scaling Amazon brands in dynamic environments.
Acute business acumen paired with adept problem-solving capabilities.
Proficiency in data analysis, interpretation, and data-driven decision-making.
Great at multitasking and prioritizing an array of simultaneous responsibilities.
An unwavering commitment to detail and a proactive approach to accomplishing objectives in a team environment.
﻿﻿How do we do things? In eBrands, we embrace being a company with a high ambition to do things bigger, better, and faster, while balancing it with being highly focused on what matters. We think like pirates we are brave, break out of traditional conventions and think creatively of solutions, while knowing we can rely on the team around us.

If we need to make mistakes, we rather make them fast and learn. We all drive to make the company a success. And we want to have fun while doing it! Originally posted on Himalayas

Position Summary Ironmark is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to support franchisees and local operators participating in multi-location marketing programs.

This role serves as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned locations, helping them understand available services, make informed marketing decisions, and get greater value from their investment.

The Strategic Account Manager connects each location’s business goals with coordinated execution across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and marketing technology.

They guide onboarding, maintain proactive communication, explain performance clearly, and help local owners navigate priorities, opportunities, and challenges. The right person will bring digital agency experience, a strong understanding of multi-location marketing, and the confidence to manage a large portfolio of local client relationships.

They should be comfortable advising business owners, interpreting performance, resolving concerns, and coordinating work across internal service teams.

Primary Responsibilities & Ownership The Strategic Account Manager owns the day-to-day experience, health, and growth of assigned location relationships, ensuring each client receives clear guidance, responsive support, and a consistent experience within the broader brand program.

Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned franchisees, local operators, and participating locations. Lead recurring location meetings, performance conversations, onboarding sessions, and planning discussions. Translate each location’s business goals, market conditions, and budget into clear marketing priorities and next steps.

Coordinate integrated programs across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and other services. Monitor location satisfaction, engagement, program adoption, performance trends, and potential risks across the assigned portfolio.

Proactively address concerns and lead difficult location-level conversations with clarity, professionalism, and sound judgment. Partner with channel specialists to interpret performance and present practical, business-focused recommendations.

Identify opportunities to improve retention, increase service adoption, and expand location participation through relevant Ironmark services.

Key Areas of Focus Location Relationship Management & Strategic Guidance Build credibility with franchisees and local operators by understanding their business goals, market conditions, challenges, and growth priorities. Help location clients prioritize marketing opportunities based on business impact, available budget, and operational readiness.

Multi-Location Program Management Manage a scalable portfolio of location relationships within larger franchise and multi-location programs. Lead location onboarding, education, adoption, and ongoing engagement across available marketing services.

Deliver a consistent client experience while adapting guidance to each location’s market, maturity, goals, and needs. Digital Marketing Strategy & Performance Understand how paid media, SEO, content, social media, web, analytics, and related services work together.

Review performance with channel experts and translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and business implications. Connect brand-level strategy and reporting with practical location-level execution, performance, and next steps.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Growth Coordinate between location clients and Ironmark ’s strategy, media, SEO, creative, web, analytics, operations, and production teams. Create clear internal direction, confirm ownership, surface risks early, and keep deliverables moving.

Partner with leadership on location retention, account planning, service adoption, and opportunities to expand participation. Qualifications Required 4+ years of client-facing account management, strategy, or client services experience in a digital marketing agency. Direct experience supporting franchise or another multi-location business model.

Experience managing a large portfolio of client relationships, workstreams, timelines, and stakeholders at the same time. Working knowledge of paid media, SEO, content, web, analytics, and performance reporting. Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful trends, and communicate practical recommendations to local business owners.

Strong written, verbal, presentation, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to navigate difficult client conversations professionally. Preferred Experience working directly with franchisees, dealers, local operators, or individual locations within a larger brand system.

Familiarity with CRM, project management, reporting, call tracking, and marketing automation tools. What Makes Someone Successful in This Role The ideal candidate understands that strong location account management is more than responsiveness.

They anticipate needs, create clarity, connect marketing activity to local business goals, and help owners make better decisions while maintaining a consistent client experience across a large portfolio.

They understand the complexity of multi-location marketing and can earn trust with franchisees and local operators who need practical guidance, reliable follow-through, and measurable value. They communicate directly, stay organized, remain calm under pressure, and bring the right internal resources together to solve problems.

Why Join Ironmark Ironmark is a growing marketing services company that brings digital, creative, print, production, data, and technology together for multi-location and franchise brands.

This role is an opportunity to work with complex client organizations, shape scalable marketing programs, and help clients connect national strategy with meaningful local-market execution. EEO Statement Ironmark is an equal opportunity employer.

Für ein international tätiges Maschinenbauunternehmen mit Sitz in Bremen suchen wir einen International Sales Manager (all genders) mit klarem Hunter-Fokus für den weltweiten Ausbau des Projektgeschäfts im Bereich Sonderanlagen.
Aufgaben
Sie akquirieren aktiv internationale Neukunden (ca. 80 %) im Anlagen- und Projektgeschäft.
Sie steuern den gesamten Vertriebsprozess – von der technischen Klärung über die Angebotserstellung bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
Sie bearbeiten internationale Ausschreibungen und prüfen englischsprachige Spezifikationen.
Sie analysieren Marktpotenziale und identifizieren neue Anwendungen, um gezielt Märkte außerhalb Europas aufzubauen, schwerpunktmäßig Asien (Reisetätigkeit ca. 30 %).
Sie arbeiten eng mit Konstruktion und Projektmanagement am Standort Bremen zusammen.
Sie repräsentieren das Unternehmen bei internationalen Kundenterminen, Fachmessen und Branchenveranstaltungen.
Qualifikation
Sie verfügen über ein Studium im Bereich Verfahrenstechnik, Maschinenbau oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – alternativ über eine kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Vertriebserfahrung.
Sie konnten bereits Erfahrungen im beratungsintensiven technischen Vertrieb sammeln, idealerweise in internationalem Kontext.
Sie bringen Erfahrung aus dem Anlagenbau mit, idealerweise in der Fest-Flüssig-Trennung oder Wasseraufbereitung.
Sie bewegen sich sicher im Projektgeschäft mit Volumina ab 5 Mio. €.
Sie kommunizieren sicher in Deutsch und Englisch.
Sie arbeiten eigenständig, unternehmerisch und sind international reisebereit.

Most sales roles come with a category problem: you spend the first half of every call convincing someone the type of thing you sell is worth caring about. This one doesn't. Nearly 500 customers in DACH are running doinstruct on their factory floors and in their logistics operations because they had an operational problem they couldn't fix any other way. Sub-2% churn across those customers means they haven't found a reason to leave.
The role sits inside a vertical pod with a dedicated SDR. Pipeline is a shared effort: SDR-generated leads plus your own outbound. The sales motion is consultative throughout, built on MEDDIC qualification and Command of the Message discovery. Deals don't reach a demo stage until they're qualified, which means the pipeline is smaller than most and the close rate is expected to reflect that.
🎯 What you'll own
Build pipeline in corporate and midmarket accounts (200-5,000 employees) across manufacturing, logistics, and construction in DACH, working your pod's SDR-generated leads and contributing your own outbound alongside.
Run discovery conversations that shift how prospects understand their frontline operations problem. Connect operational friction to euros before the product enters the conversation.
Qualify hard against MEDDIC criteria and kill deals early when the signal isn't there. Your forecast credibility depends on it.
Build business cases that reach Geschäftsführer or Operations Director level without a sales overlay.
Close multi-stakeholder deals, including multi-year contracts when the fit is there.

Full-cycle AE experience at a B2B SaaS company, preferably in manufacturing, logistics, or operational enterprise environments.
Track record of building your own outbound alongside SDR support, with specific accounts you personally initiated and moved forward.
Practiced use of MEDDIC or a comparable qualification framework across your full pipeline.
Experience selling to operations or line-of-business decision-makers in the 200-5,000 employee range, reaching the economic buyer independently.
Fluent German.
🤩 What's different here
Most buyers in this space have tried to fix the frontline training problem with spreadsheets or manual workarounds, and they're still carrying it.

There's no worn category here, no "we had a bad experience with something similar." You're selling a solution most prospects didn't know existed as a working option, backed by 500 customers who can confirm it does. The conversation starts from the premise that the problem is real.

The work is getting prospects to put a number on what it's costing them, before you've mentioned a feature.
The harder part is qualification discipline. The sales process is designed around a 70% close rate on qualified opportunities, and that's only achievable if the pipeline reflects actual deals. Carrying something that should be killed costs more than walking away early. For the right seller, that constraint is what makes the role worth doing.
🚀 Why doinstruct
Nearly 500 customers in DACH, Series A funded, sub-2% churn. The market proof is real.
Georg Wesinger coaches the methodology directly, in the deals you're working rather than through quarterly dashboards.
The sales team is senior. You'll get better at your craft by being in the room.
Vertical focus means you build real expertise in specific markets over time, not a generalist territory that resets every two years.

About Emerald Emerald ’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce.

We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in-person and digital platforms and channels.

For more information, please visit ASD Market Week is one of the largest and longest-running business-to-business general merchandise trade shows in the United States.

Held twice annually in Las Vegas, ASD connects thousands of retailers, distributors, importers, and e-commerce businesses with manufacturers, wholesalers, and suppliers from around the world.

With more than 1,800 vendors, approximately 30,000 attendees, and over one million products across 19+ merchandise categories, ASD provides exhibitors with a powerful platform to meet new customers, enter new markets, build brand visibility, and write business directly on the show floor.

We are seeking a motivated, commercially driven Account Executive to grow exhibitor and sponsorship revenue for ASD Market Week. The Account Executive will manage the complete sales cycle—from identifying and prospecting new business opportunities through discovery, proposal development, negotiation, closing, and renewal.

This role will primarily engage manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, importers, suppliers, and consumer-product brands that would benefit from reaching ASD’s diverse community of retail buyers.

The successful candidate will be a proactive new-business hunter who is comfortable conducting high-volume outbound prospecting, building relationships with senior decision-makers, and presenting tailored event solutions that deliver measurable value to customers. Key Responsibilities New Business Development
Identify and prospect manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, suppliers, and emerging brands that align with ASD Market Week’s buyer community.
Generate new business through telephone outreach, email campaigns, LinkedIn, industry research, referrals, inbound leads, networking, and competitive-event prospecting.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified exhibit and sponsorship opportunities.
Develop targeted prospecting strategies across relevant product categories, including general merchandise, fashion and accessories, beauty and wellness, gift and home, toys, convenience-store products, closeouts, liquidation, and private-label manufacturing.
Re-engage dormant, lapsed, and previously lost exhibitors with relevant and compelling commercial proposals.
Consultative Sales and Closing
Own the full sales cycle from initial outreach and qualification through proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close.
Conduct effective discovery conversations to understand each prospect’s products, target customers, business objectives, challenges, and growth strategy.
Clearly communicate ASD Market Week’s value proposition and demonstrate how participation can help customers generate leads, meet qualified buyers, enter new markets, increase brand visibility, and grow revenue.
Recommend appropriate booth packages, sponsorships, digital products, marketing opportunities, and other solutions based on customer needs and objectives.
Prepare proposals, negotiate commercial terms, overcome objections, create urgency, and consistently move opportunities toward close.
Meet or exceed individual revenue, new-business, renewal, activity, and productivity targets.
Account Growth and Retention
Develop strong relationships with new and existing exhibitors, serving as a knowledgeable and trusted commercial partner.
Manage a portfolio of assigned accounts and identify opportunities for renewal, expansion, upselling, cross-selling, and multi-show participation.
Conduct structured post-show follow-up to review exhibitor outcomes, gather feedback, address concerns, and secure future participation.
Work proactively to reduce cancellations and improve exhibitor retention.
Maintain regular communication with customers throughout the event cycle to ensure expectations are clearly understood and appropriately managed.
Pipeline Management and Forecasting
Maintain complete and accurate customer, activity, opportunity, and contract information within the CRM.
Manage opportunities through clearly defined pipeline stages with documented next steps and realistic close dates.
Produce accurate weekly and monthly sales forecasts.
Monitor personal pacing against revenue goals, activity expectations, and event deadlines.
Use CRM data, category insights, sales reports, and market intelligence to prioritize accounts and identify areas of opportunity.
Maintain strong pipeline discipline and immediately escalate material risks, blockers, or forecast changes.
Collaboration and Event Delivery
Partner closely with marketing, operations, customer success, finance, and event leadership to deliver a strong exhibitor experience.
Provide customer and marketplace feedback to support product development, pricing, marketing campaigns, and show-floor strategy.
Coordinate the successful handoff of contracted exhibitors to the appropriate operational and customer-success teams.
Attend ASD Market Week and other relevant industry events, supporting customers onsite and developing new sales opportunities.
Represent ASD and Emerald professionally in all customer and industry interactions.

Two or more years of successful B2B sales, business development, account management, media sales, event sales, or sponsorship sales experience.
Demonstrated ability to generate new business through proactive outbound prospecting.
Proven record of meeting or exceeding individual sales targets.
Experience managing the complete sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation and close.
Strong consultative-selling, presentation, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.
Ability to build credibility and relationships with business owners, founders, sales leaders, marketing executives, and other senior decision-makers.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of accounts, opportunities, and deadlines.
Experience using CRM and sales-enablement platforms; Salesforce experience is preferred.
Strong forecasting discipline and attention to CRM accuracy.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven, and deadline-oriented sales environment.
Ability and willingness to travel to ASD Market Week in Las Vegas and other relevant industry events.
Trade-show, wholesale, retail, consumer-products, media, or events-industry experience is preferred but not required.

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory.

The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.
The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts.

The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

Territory Strategy & Business Performance
Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.
Strategic Account Management & Network Development
Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.
Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement
Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.
Influence & Impact
Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries
Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact
Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights
Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.
Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture
Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.

About Hiya
At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.
Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.
Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. More about Nash
Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.
Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one.

Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.
Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network.

Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.
We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.
Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

The Sales Account Director will join a team driving TRM's crypto go-to-market strategy for Public Sector customers in the DACH region. Your goal will be to increase and strengthen our foothold in the space. We're looking for a customer-focused , consultative salesperson to own the entire sales process with new and existing customers. This person will be knowledgeable about the cryptocurrency ecosystem and feel comfortable navigating complex processes to close six and seven figure deals.

s.h: The impact you will have here
s.t:
Account Mapping — Connect with all the current key stakeholders within your territory
Prospecting — Discover new stakeholders within your territory
Nurturing — Own, plan, execute, and/or quarterback activities to nurture client relationships, feedback loops, referrals, renewals, upsells, cross-sells, expansions
Account Planning — Create and execute strategic plans for your territory
Product and Subject Matter Expertise — Hone TRM product and customer vertical subject matter expertise
Customer Advocacy — Proactively gather and prioritize customer feedback and champion it within TRM
Loyalty — Develop a roster of happy customers that will refer new prospects, champion TRM, and provide crucial feedback

At least 5+ years of experience selling SaaS products into Public Sector accounts in the DACH region
Strong customer-facing presentation/listening skills with the ability to establish credibility with senior executives
A knack for storytelling — ability to understand customer needs and build compelling value propositions
Adaptable. Goals can change fast. You anticipate and react quickly.
Autonomous, collaborative and an excellent communicator

TRM's EMEA Sales Team has a fast paced, positive and open culture. Team members are given a high degree of responsibility and autonomy. The team gets together for calls regularly. Your manager tries to be available to assist you with questions, problems or at customer meetings.
Application Instructions
If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.
Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.
If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

s.h: What to Expect From Our Interview Process
s.t:
Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.
Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.
Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.
Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.
Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.
Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.
Learn more about interviewing at TRM
Life at TRM
We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.
TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.
Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate
Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes
This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.
We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.
At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more: Interviewing at TRM: How We Hire and What Success Looks Like
AI Fluency at TRM
AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.
We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.
At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:
Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage
You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.
Leadership Principles
We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.
Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
